title: Anova Power Interruption Count
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=anova:session event=power_restore
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as interruptions by device _time
| where interruptions>0
| sort - interruptions
description: Uses Anova power-restore events telemetry to monitor how often cooks were interrupted by power loss or reconnect in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for sous-vide jobs that were at risk of failing, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Anova power-restore events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how often cooks were interrupted by power loss or reconnect so you can spot sous-vide jobs that were at risk of failing before it becomes annoying.
